dark.label: Dark
dark.describe: albedo of the hooves, the eyes and the nostrils, the darkest thing on the animal

size.label: Size
size.describe: Rebuilds the whole animal and its bind skeleton in metres for a herd: 1.0 is the adult bull of the reference, about 6.3 m from brow-horn tip to tail tip, 2.85 m over the back and 3.65 m to the top of the shield; 0.6 a 3.8 m subadult whose head, shield and horns are relatively about 6% larger against its body; 1.4 an 8.7 m old bull whose head is relatively 4% smaller. Feet stay on y = 0.

horns.label: Brow horns
horns.describe: Length and sweep of the two brow horns, rebuilt from the same thick base on the brow boss straight over the eye: 1.0 is about 1.25 m, rising about 30 degrees in profile with the tips about 0.17 m past the beak, splayed out to about 0.62 m either side of the midline and, from behind, inside the shield outline; 0.7 short, more upright 0.9 m horns of a young adult (about 34 degrees) that stop over the snout; 1.3 long 1.6 m horns of an old bull that sweep further forward and lower, about 25 degrees, their tips just over the shield rim from behind. The nose horn, the shield and the head do not change.

noseHorn.label: Nose horn
noseHorn.describe: Length of the short horn on the snout: 1.0 is the reference's short 0.32 m cone, leaning forward about 45 degrees over the beak; 0.6 a low 0.19 m boss; 1.5 a 0.48 m spike. Its base and the beak do not change.

frillSize.label: Shield size
frillSize.describe: Reach of the shield from its base on the skull to its knobbed rim: 1.0 is the reference, a round 1.9 m wide shield (over its knobs, no wider than the body from the front) whose top stands 3.65 m up, leaning back over the neck; 0.85 a smaller shield about 1.8 m wide, 3.5 m up; 1.15 a big display shield about 2.05 m wide, 3.8 m up. The knobs ride the rim and stay the same size.

tail.label: Tail length
tail.describe: Length of the tail behind the rump: 1.0 is the reference, a short thick tapering 1.5 m tail hanging off the rump, its tip about 0.95 m up, clear of the ground; 0.85 a stubby 1.3 m tail; 1.15 a longer 1.75 m tail. Its root and depth do not change.

frill.label: Frill
frill.describe: Pattern on the front of the shield, painted on the shield's own facet rings so it lands on whole faces and mirrors across the midline; the edge knobs keep the trim colour in every pattern. plain: the plain hide-coloured shield with cream knobs, its back the darker umber of the reference's bowl (the reference). banded: concentric rust-red and pale bands round a hide-coloured centre. eyespots: a big dark eyespot (the pupils' own near-black) ringed pale on a rust field each side. rayed: rust rays running from the crest out to the edge knobs on the hide-coloured shield. Sets the shieldTrim and shieldMark colour zones, which explicit colour values still override.

materials_note: what each colour zone is made of: `kind` and `finish` name a procedural PBR material in https://polyfork.dev/materials.mjs (dressByAlbedo finds a zone by its albedo in COLOR_0). A zone not listed has not been classified.
